up: Retrieve all compounds linked to the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5441456. Return the following columns for each compound: ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES string.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5441456'
